# Contract: Gherkin options

Added to the `gherkin` block of the doc-kitty site configuration.

```js
gherkin: {
  sources: ['features'],
  // #197: a page option (changes generated bytes; mirrored by a CLI flag)
  defaultGlossaryContext: { shipping: 'shipping', hr: 'hr', 'shipping/eu': 'customs' },
  // #196: a non-page option (never changes generated bytes)
  lint: {
    imperativeSteps: true, // or false (default), or { verbs, extend, keywords }
  },
}
```

| Option | Group | Default | Errors (thrown at startup, `[dk-gherkin]` prefix) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `defaultGlossaryContext` | page key (`GHERKIN_PAGES_KEYS`) | absent | not a plain object; bad key (absolute, `..`, backslash, empty); blank value; set without `sources` |
| `lint` | option key (`GHERKIN_OPTION_KEYS`) | absent (off) | not an object; unknown key under `lint` |
| `lint.imperativeSteps` | — | `false` | not boolean or object; unknown key; non-string or blank entry; keyword not in `context`, `action`, `outcome`; empty effective list |

**Compatibility**: with neither option set, every generated page and every
build log is identical to before.
